memberdef.initializer: do { \ while (1) { \ if (!syn_tcp_pt_args_valid((pt), (task), (conn), (buf), (bytes_read))) { \ return PT_EXITED; \ } \ (conn)->blocked_task = (task); \ syn_port_enter_critical(); \ if ((task)->state == (uint8_t)SYN_TASK_READY) { \ (task)->state = (uint8_t)SYN_TASK_BLOCKED; \ SYN_PT_STATE_BARRIER(); \ } \ syn_port_exit_critical(); \ if ((conn)->rx_len > 0U || (conn)->state != SYN_TCP_ESTABLISHED) { \ syn_port_enter_critical(); \ if ((task)->state == (uint8_t)SYN_TASK_BLOCKED) { \ (task)->state = (uint8_t)SYN_TASK_READY; \ } \ syn_port_exit_critical(); \ break; \ } \ PT_PASS(pt); \ } \ syn_tcp_pt_recv((conn), (buf), (max_len), (bytes_read)); \ } while (0)
